2: 
3: We will expand the **Broker & Integrations** dashboard in `src/pages/Settings.tsx` to support 10 global Forex/CFD brokers, introduce MT4 and WhatsApp integrations, implement a dual-action "Open Partner Account / Link Account" modal tab interface, and align all fonts and weights to guarantee absolute visual consistency.
4: 
5: ## User Review Required
6: 
7: > [!IMPORTANT]
8: > The expansion includes:
9: > 1. **Complete 10-Broker Database**: We will render five primary brokers in the card list (Exness, IC Markets, Pepperstone, FP Markets, XM) and display a "View all brokers" modal containing all 10 brokers (adding HFM, AvaTrade, FXTM, OANDA, Forex.com).
10: > 2. **Double-Action Connection Interface**: The connection modal will feature tabs:
11: >    - **Open Partner Account**: Shows broker information, referral link button, and "+500 XP Reward" indicator.
12: >    - **Link Existing Account**: Standard secure API link form (Account Number, Master Password, Server Name).
13: > 3. **Expanded Integrations List**: Adding **MetaTrader 4 Sync** and **WhatsApp Alerts** alongside TradingView, Telegram, and Discord.
14: > 4. **Strict Font & Size Auditing**: We will audit all text weights and sizes to ensure they align exactly with other Settings tabs.
